data.name: The Horror Quest
data.detailed_description:
The world of entertainment has changed. Extreme adventures have become fashionable in modern life, and horror quests are a new way to test yourself. But behind the bright posters, there is a dark truth.
The Horror Quest is a project of a secret organization that creates bloody shows under the guise of games. There are no scripts and safe zones here - only real danger, primal fear and the fight for life.
Together with other players, you will: Explore creepy locations full of traps and riddles.
Find items and clues to open the way to salvation.
Decide who to trust and who to betray for your own salvation.
Survive in conditions where every wrong move can be your last.

Will you be able to get out of the game alive?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 versions 2004 and 20H2, or Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1400, or Intel Core i7-3770, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1060 6GB, or analog with support for hardware or software ray tracing
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to use SSD drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 versions 2004 and 20H2, or Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5700x, or Intel Core i7-11700K, or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX2060S (1080p), RTX2080Ti (1440p), or similar with hardware or software ray tracing support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to use SSD drive
